parameter_contract.defaults_reason: Only scientific default R=0 is preserved from Amphlett_Params_Default. No demonstration scientific vector is used as a default. Optional output directory resolves to cwd/results; fixed internal Name=polarization changes report filenames only.

adaptations: Validate finite values, positive physical domains, nonnegative electronic resistance, integer cell count and increasing nonnegative sweep.
Reject lambda outside14..23 instead of accepting upstream filter_lambda silent replacement; the scientific implementation is unchanged.
Use the actual upstream get_precision/rounder helpers to reject nonadvancing sweeps and fewer than two points needed by native linear fit.
Operational limit10,000samples protects accidental oversized calls; this is documented resource policy, not a new model domain.
Call Static_Analysis exactly once with a fresh native input dict, TestMode=True, PrintMode=False, ReportMode=True, and invocation-specific Folder.
Serialize source calls while capturing stdout/stderr into upstream.log; source errors can print despite PrintMode=False.
Reject incomplete/nonfinite native arrays or fit scalars rather than treating swallowed source failures as valid scientific results.
Retain complete original result dictionary as native-result.json, native reports and inputs; return concise summaries and absolute artifact paths, not curve arrays over MCP.
Preserve provenance and explicit scope/units warnings. Compact maximum is the maximum sampled native P output, not an invented optimization algorithm.
scientific_transformations: None; model formulas and native result arrays are not modified or recomputed.

checks.command: opem-env/bin/python inline async FastMCP Client(amphlett_mcp), list_tools and call_tool with official input
checks.temporary_output_policy: TemporaryDirectory under /tmp; smoke outputs removed after comparison; immutable official source evidence remains under notebooks/amphlett_reference/.

attempts.note: Initial implementation passed import and real in-process MCP official-vector smoke; independent verifier remains required.

limitations: Development smoke is not independent scientific verification, real stdio acceptance, clean-environment or ZIP relocation validation.
OPEM static prescribedT/lambda model does not solve air-cooled thermal balance, fan power, water dynamics or spatial gradients.
PO2 is species partial pressure, Ph uses native fixedEth=1.23 and is not a validated fan-sizing heat load.
Source-native HTML reports require external JavaScript. Only Linux Python3.12 was exercised at this stage.
